name: cve_lookup
description: Search the National Vulnerability Database (NVD) for known CVEs (vulnerabilities). Call with action='search' and a keyword for general searches, action='get' with a specific CVE ID (format CVE-YYYY-NNNNN) for full details on one vulnerability, action='by_product' to find CVEs affecting a named software product, or action='by_severity' to filter by CRITICAL/HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW.

action.description: search: keyword search. get: full details for one CVE ID. by_product: CVEs affecting a named product. by_severity: filter by severity level.

cve_id.description: A specific CVE identifier in the exact format CVE-YYYY-NNNNN (e.g. 'CVE-2024-12345'). Required for action='get'. Never pass a free-text description here - only a real CVE ID.

product.description: Software product name (e.g. 'apache', 'openssl'). Required for action='by_product'.

severity.description: Severity level to filter by. Required for action='by_severity'.

limit.description: Max results to return. Defaults to 10.
